name: keep-awake
title: Keep Awake
description: Keep the Mac awake with the lid closed, indefinitely or for a fixed duration
author: uphy

commands.name: keep-awake
commands.title: Keep Awake
commands.description: Show whether the Mac is being kept awake, and turn it on or off with an optional timer

preferences.name: timerPresets
preferences.title: Timer Presets
preferences.description: Durations offered when turning Keep Awake on. Comma-separated, m for minutes and h for hours.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
